Most of the consultancy industry’s professionals hold university degrees 
(percentage in Spain)
Due to the type of services offered, consulting fir-
ms attract the most qualified profiles in the job 
market.  65.8%  of the total number of professio-
nals in 2024 were university graduates.  Another 
year again, the percentage of women with a hi-
gher education was above that of men (70.8% ver-
sus 63.8%).
On the other hand, the presence of vocational tra-
ining graduates dropped with respect to the year 
before, representing 20.1% of the total in 2.24.  In 
this case, the percentage of women, 13.9% of the 
total, was less than the men, which represented 
22.9%.
